title: Upstream crosslink request: structured close-reason / disposition field on issue close
description:
For operator relay to the crosslink project.

Request: add a structured, queryable close-reason / disposition field to crosslink issues (set at close, exposed in 'issue show --json' and ideally 'issue list --json'). Values vsdd-cli needs: dismissed, hallucinated, consolidated (with a survivor reference for consolidated).

Why: vsdd-cli's unrouted-findings process-integrity query (vsdd-core/src/answer/integrity.rs) must exempt disposition closures. crosslink today stores no structured disposition — 'issue close' takes no reason, 'issue update' has no disposition field, and no disposition labels are in use. So the finding-query join (vsdd-cli #820, .design/finding-query-join.md) adopts an interim disposition LABEL-carry (dismissed/hallucinated/consolidated labels read from 'issue show'). A structured close-reason field would supersede that label convention: the join's read moves from labels to the field with no query-side change.

Supersedes: the disposition label-carry adopted in .design/finding-query-join.md (D1 / REQ-9), which exists only because this surface is absent. Relates to vsdd-cli #820.
